title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
summary: DataOrchestra 提出一种针对预训练数据逐样本定制的处理框架，通过编排器为每个数据块决策丢弃、保留或清洗，并选择程序编辑或 LLM 重写等下游操作，生成具体指令执行，以替代传统固定策略，提升 LLM 下游性能。

extra.description: Pretraining data processing is critical to the downstream performance of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, many existing approaches define a fixed processing strategy at the corpus or domain level and apply it uniformly to many examples, without adapting to the needs of each example. We propose DataOrchestra, a framework that unifies different processing operations and orchestrates an example-specific pipeline for each example.
